note: Third held-out set: 30 messages (15 scam, 15 benign) written by a third party (Gemini). It was NOT seen while the round 1 rules were written, but its misses were then seen and used for rule tuning in round 2, so it is no longer an unseen measure (heldout4 is the new reserved set). English-only: the original draft had 3 romanized-Bengali messages, replaced by English versions because the engine is English-only. Do not tune rules on it further. Messages use the same fields as heldout2.json: { id, label, category, text }.
